in_hebrew.name: Elaina
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Light, sunny, ray
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Elaina הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Helaine', meaning 'shining light' or 'sun ray'. In Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun, and his daughter, Helia or Helene, was the goddess of the sun or the sun's light.
